name: Trader Joe's Frozen Chicken Tikka Masala with Cumin Basmati Rice
whyItWorks: Trader Joe's top-selling frozen meal: tender roasted chicken breast pieces simmered in a creamy, mild tomato-fenugreek curry paired with fluffy steamed white basmati rice. Basmati rice is an elite soothing starch, and the sauce is mild without fiery chili heat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4–5 minutes until steaming. Take a lactase enzyme tablet for the cream in the tikka sauce.
watchOuts: Contains heavy cream and butter in the sauce; take lactase if dairy sensitive.
